scenarioEasy.reason: Easy mode removes each encounter card with a gold border around its encounter set icon (easy-mode.easy-mode, Easy Mode p1: "remove any card with the “difficulty” indicator around its encounter set icon (a gold border)"; ltp.easy-mode step 2 says the same). The pinned scan scans/141069.A.jpg (sha256 c90559759d78bcecceea3394cd291f90169bd3107b774f0e641913763baba0c6) shows copy 2/11 with a silver border, so at least one Ringwraith stays in Easy. It cannot decide between 2 and 4: the gold mark is printed per copy and the sync pins one scan per code and side. Hall of Beorn gives 2 (scenario list and card record); the DragnCards Easy deck keeps all 4. The user chose Hall of Beorn's 2 on 2026-10-24. Normal mode is unaffected.

campaigns.name: The Two Towers
campaigns.reason: No source names a campaign. Hall of Beorn numbers the Saga scenarios 1-18 in book order and groups them by pack: The Black Riders and The Road Darkens are 1-6 (the Fellowship campaign built here), The Treason of Saruman 7-9 and The Land of Shadow 10-12 follow it. The pairing of the packs into one campaign and the campaign's name (the title of the book its scenarios follow) are the saga's published structure, recorded here because no fetched source states them; the scenario count is Hall of Beorn's listing.

productCodes.reason: Hall of Beorn numbers The Dark of Mirkwood's cards 02001 to 02051, which are the codes RingsDB gives The Hunt for Gollum (02004 is Winged Guardian and also Surprise Attack). RingsDB lists the nine burden, boon and adaptation cards of the box as 41041 to 41049 (Stalking Goblin is 02041 in Hall of Beorn and 41041 in RingsDB). The code is therefore 410 and the two-digit collector number, for every card of the box, so the quest, encounter and campaign cards RingsDB does not list take the same pattern (After the Raid 41001, The Oath 41050).
productCodes.source: hallofbeorn.com/Export/EncounterCards, QuestCards, PlayerCards (CardSet The Dark of Mirkwood, Number); ringsdb.com pack TDoM (41041 to 41049)

encounterSetAliases.reason: The Revised Core Set's Learn to Play (p25) and the Easy Mode sheet (p2) call the second core scenario and its encounter set "Journey Down the Anduin". The scenario's own campaign card, quest cards and encounter set icon print "Journey Along the Anduin" (Mirkwood Paths - Part 2, scan 01130.A), and Hall of Beorn follows the cards. The card wins (authority order); the booklet's name is an alias.
